text.p: Fibreboard Corp on Monday said it completed its acquisition of Florida-based assets of Gentek Building Products Inc for about $11 million, including the assumption of its trade payable obligations.
The assets acquired in the cash deal included 10 building-product distribution sites in Florida and two manufacturing plants that fabricate aluminum windows and doors.
The company said it expected these operations to generate about $35 million of revenues and contribute between $0.05 and $0.10 earnings per share.

John Roach, Fibreboard's chairman, said: "As we explained when we announced the agreement to purchase Gentek's Florida operations, this acquisition expands our distribution platform for growth and positions us as a leading participant in the Florida building products market."
